name: Equinix
description: Global colocation and interconnection REIT operating more than 250 IBX data centres across five continents; runs a decade-long on-site fuel-cell programme with Bloom Energy (more than 100 MW across about 19 sites) and signs long-term clean-power agreements for its AI-era expansion.

sources.note: The Register, 14 August 2025 (Equinix power agreements incl. >100 MW Bloom fuel cells), read via search summary 2026-11-12
